title: Snapchat Notification
blurb: Streak maintenance is not optional, and this is the sound that enforces it. Snapchat's alert carries a very specific teenage urgency no other notification comes close to: it might mean a snap, it might mean somebody screenshotted something they absolutely should not have, and there is only one way to find out. The app's entire retention model rests on that ambiguity. Play it near anyone under twenty-five and observe the immediate, slightly panicked check. For everyone else it is a useful reminder that a hundred-day streak is technically a hostage situation.
